stemBlocks: A series of $100 \text{ mm}$ long samples have a square cross-section of $5 \text{ mm} \times 5 \text{ mm}$. Each sample is tested in an apparatus which applies increasing tension to the ends of the sample until it breaks. The length of the sample is measured and a plot of tension vs extension obtained. The results for five samples S1-S5 are shown in the figure below. Which of the samples is the stiffest compared to the other samples?

assets.alt: A plot of tension vs extension for five samples S1-S5.
